feeds.title: Gartex Texprocess India Blog
feeds.description: Gartex is a comprehensive tradeshow on garment textile machinery. It provides a unique platform for international and national suppliers and trade visitors to expand their business opportunities in the garment and textile industry in India through networking and engaging in investment opportunities during the show. Follow their blog to know more about the textile industry, their business, market research, industry trends, news, updates, and more.

feeds.title: Textile South Asia
feeds.description: Established in 2022, Textile South Asia is the definitive source of information for the South Asia textile industry. Acclaimed as the leading e-textile magazine, this publication by Abelian Techno is avidly read every month by decision-makers from the industry with its sustained focus on technology and trade. Check out their blog which delivers daily news, updates, analysis, case studies, and industry scoops related to the textile industry of South Asia.

feeds.title: Damodar Menon Blog
feeds.description: Damodar Menon International Pvt. Ltd is one of the top textile trading companies in India, with an ISO 9001:2005 certification. It is headed and promoted by the Menon family. The company trades spun yarn, cotton yarn, wool yarn, polyester yarn, melange yarn, and greige fabric worldwide. Over the past 60 years, they have collaborated with some of the most renowned brands and businesses, globally. Visit their blog which features posts on topics such as Fabric Types, industry trends, market research, feature stories, industry news, updates, and more.

feeds.title: Indian Textile Journal
feeds.description: Established in 1890, the Indian Textile Journal is the definitive source of information for the Indian textile industry. Acclaimed as the leading textile magazine, this publication by ASAPP Global Group is avidly read every month by decision-makers from the industry with its sustained focus on technology and trade. Wade through their blog and learn more about the latest industry news, updates, resources, and more.

feeds.title: Apparel Views
feeds.description: Apparel Views is India's fastest-growing and leading monthly trade publication that provides an array of information on the rapidly changing world. Extensively read by garment manufacturers and exporters, it updates the readers on news and views, fashion trends, expert opinion, market information, and technological developments happening in the apparel and textile sector from all over the world. Here you can learn more about their services, news, updates, and more.

feeds.title: Online Clothing Study
feeds.description: Online Clothing Study is a garment manufacturing, clothing study, sewing systems, industrial engineering, fashion technology, textiles, and apparel production. It is a web resource for learning apparel manufacturing. Dive into their blog that publishes articles on apparel manufacturing, the technology used in the garment industry, and the latest news, about events, and fairs related to apparel, and more.

feeds.title: Apparel Resources
feeds.description: Apparel Resources brings the two worlds of Buyers and Sellers in the Apparel and Textile industry together on a single platform through its vast pool of contemporary, insightful and compelling information. Though the portal tracks in real-time the news that matters, each and every article is an analysis of the apparel, textile and fashion industry written and vetted by industry experts who have rich experience and a deep understanding of the local as well as the export markets.

feeds.title: The Textile Magazine
feeds.description: Textile Magazine is the only corporate news magazine on the Indian textile industry. Today, it has become a must-read magazine for all CEOs and professionals from the textile industry. Dive into their blog that shares the latest news, updates, e-magazines, and more.

feeds.title: Locofast Blog
feeds.description: Locofast is a leading tech-enabled platform for textile procurement services in India. Connecting textile suppliers and vendors from all over the world through their platform, they aim to streamline the currently broken supply chain by solving all textile procurement problems. They dedicate themselves to building an ecosystem that enables their partners with operational excellence and unlimited growth opportunities. Explore more through their blog and learn about their services, network, media, articles, news, updates, and more.

feeds.title: Indian Apparel
feeds.description: Indian Apparel Blog that talks about apparel and textile news, events, and fairs. It is India's B2B Apparel hub aiding garment manufacturers, wholesalers, and retailers to trade with each other. Their commitment to ground-breaking editorial remains as strong as ever, and Indian apparel is rightly acknowledged as the essential business tool for apparel and textile agents, distributors, exporters, retailers, and manufacturers around India and other parts of the World. Visit their blog and learn more about news in the dynamic world of apparel and textiles in India and worldwide.

feeds.title: The Indian Saree Journal Blog
feeds.description: The Indian Saree Journal admires sarees and is completely humbled by their woven treasures and inspiring stories of people behind textiles. The wondrous Indian fabrics have enchanted them, each and every day is a learning. From a textile enthusiast to a researcher, this blog is a journal of learning about this wonderful journey.

feeds.title: Indian Textile House Blog
feeds.description: Indian Textile House is your home for all your textile requirements. They bring B2B businesses a wide variety of fabrics, sarees, dress materials, lehengas, dupattas, and much more. They have the widest network of reliable and established manufacturers who have been catering to this industry for years. It is known for its authenticity and reliability in its approach to the associated business partners. Browse through their blog and learn more about their services, offers, fabrics, news, updates, and more.

feeds.title: Faze Three Limited Blog
feeds.description: Faze Three Limited is a global textile force with a vision to become a part of every home textile and a Mission to have a presence in every textile segment with outstanding quality and diversity in home textiles. It was established in 1985 and is today a well-known home textile manufacturer and automotive fabric manufacturer in India. Go through their blog and learn more about their business, their products, industry news, updates, and more.

feeds.title: My Textile Notes
feeds.description: Textile Notes is managed and owned by Priyank Goel. It is related to fiber, yarn, fabric knowledge, spinning, weaving, processing, projects, knitting, Indian traditional textiles, and denim manufacturing. With extensive experience in textile manufacturing, Indian ethnic apparel retail, and Indian traditional textiles, he has had the opportunity to explore various handloom and power-loom clusters across India. Check his blog and learn more about services, books, articles, lectures, and more.
